prompt:
The section sections/app-download-banner.liquid promotes the store's mobile app. Its markup uses whitespace-trimming tags ({%- -%}, {{- -}}) throughout and strips the text settings before printing them. The {% schema %} block is out of sync with the markup. It has no block definition even though the markup loops over feature blocks. It has invalid range defaults, a select with no default, no group restriction and no preset. Do not change the markup. Replace only the schema JSON so it equals exactly the following, with keys and array entries in this order.

Top level:
- name "App download"
- tag "section"
- class "app-download-section"
- disabled_on {"groups":["header","footer"]}
- settings, blocks, max_blocks 5, presets

Section settings, in order:
1. text, id heading, label "Heading", default "Get the app"
2. textarea, id description, label "Description", default "Shop faster with our mobile app."
3. image_picker, id qr_image, label "QR code image"
4. url, id app_store_url, label "App Store link"
5. url, id google_play_url, label "Google Play link"
6. select, id layout, label "Layout", options [{value "image_first", label "Image first"}, {value "text_first", label "Text first"}], default "image_first"
7. range, id padding_top, label "Top padding", min 0, max 100, step 4, unit "px", default 36
8. range, id padding_bottom, label "Bottom padding", min 0, max 100, step 4, unit "px", default 36

Blocks: one block type, with type "feature", name "Feature" and a single setting: text, id text, label "Feature text", default "Exclusive app-only deals".

Within each setting, the key order is: type, id, label, then options for select, then min/max/step/unit for range, and finally default.

max_blocks: 5.

presets: exactly one preset. Its name is "App download" and its blocks are two entries, each {"type":"feature"}.

There are no other keys. Range defaults must be numbers, not strings. Change only sections/app-download-banner.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
